import sys
sys.path[:0]=['/workspace/tmp/tests','/opt/emicro-deps','/workspace/project']
from ebpf.create_dfa import create, registry_columns
from brute import brute_image
reg=[{'name':'A','label':10},{'name':'B','label':4}]
cols,colmap=registry_columns(reg)
cases=['match(B) allow; match(A,B) allow;',
       'not(contains()) allow;',
       'not(match()) allow;',
       'match(A) allow; match(B) allow; match(A,B) drop;',
       'contains(A) allow; match(A) drop;',
       'endswith(A) allow; endswith(B) allow;',
       '(startswith(A) and endswith(B)) or match(A,B)'.replace('(','').replace(')','')+' allow;' if False else 'match(A,B) allow; startswith(B) drop;']
for c in cases:
    img=create(c,cols,colmap)
    got={'accept':list(img.accept),'rows':[list(r) for r in img.rows]}
    try:
        ref=brute_image(c,cols,colmap,5,5)
    except Exception as e:
        ref='ERR %s'%e
    print(('OK  ' if got==ref else 'DIFF'),repr(c))
    print('    got',got['accept'],got['rows'])
    if got!=ref: print('    ref',ref['accept'],ref['rows'])
